name: Where does the capital come from?
notes:
Expect the country's last token to restore the capital from the first layer through layer 9, and the last token to take over only in layers 10 and 11.

The question: GPT-2 small completes “The capital of France is” with “ Paris” rather than another country's capital. Where does the country become its capital?

Published: Meng et al. 2022, “Locating and editing factual associations in GPT” (NeurIPS 2022), traced facts in GPT-2 XL by corrupting the subject with noise and restoring one hidden state at a time (causal tracing). Two sites restored the fact: an early site at the subject's last token, in the middle layers, and a late site at the last token, in the last layers. At the early site, restoring MLP outputs ten layers at a time restored far more than attention did; at the late site, attention mattered. GPT-2 medium and large showed the same picture.

How it is measured: causal tracing, with another country instead of noise. Each corrupt prompt (another country of the same token length) runs with the residual stream before one layer, at one position, taken from the clean prompt (clean → corrupt): at the country's last token, or at the last token. The metric is the logit difference between the clean prompt's capital and the corrupt prompt's; an effect of 1 restores it fully. The 96 prompt pairs come from Logogram's factual recall task, seed 0, with its three default templates and only capitals that are single tokens.

Measured on GPT-2 small at revision 607a30d: the logit difference is 5.77 clean and −5.76 corrupt. At the country's last token the residual stream restores 0.93 to 0.95 of the gap in layers 0 to 6, still 0.82 at layer 9, then 0.47 and 0.17 in layers 10 and 11. At the last token it restores almost nothing up to layer 8 (0.05 at most), then 0.13, 0.48 and 0.78 in layers 9 to 11. Both sites are there, as the paper found, but GPT-2 small moves the capital to the last token late, in its last three layers. As in the paper, attention matters at the late site: patched at the last token in the same way, attention in layers 9 and 10 restores 0.33 and 0.27, and in layers 0 to 7 at most 0.03. Patched one at a time in the same way, single MLP outputs at the country don't show the paper's middle-layer MLPs: MLP 0 restores 0.77, and each later MLP 0.04 or less (0.24 together in layers 1 to 8). The paper restored ten MLP layers at once and corrupted with noise, so this example checks its two sites, not its claim about MLPs.
